name: Scrub Island Resort, Spa & Marina
positioning: Resort on a secluded private island off Tortola in the British Virgin Islands, with hillside villas, Ixora Spa and its own deep-water marina
best_for: Families and groups wanting a multi-bedroom villa with a private pool and butler service
Sailors, yacht owners and sport fishermen who want a resort with its own marina

facts.text: Scrub Island is 1.5 miles off the coast of Tortola, the largest island in the British Virgin Islands.
Tortola is home to the Terrance B. Lettsome International Airport (EIS).
The villas are nestled into lush hillsides and come in 2-, 3-, 4- and 6-bedroom floor plans.
Villas have a private plunge pool or an infinity-edge pool, with views of the Caribbean and surrounding islands.
Suites add a full gourmet kitchen, a spacious living area and a large balcony.
Weekly yoga sessions are held on the terrace at Ixora Spa, with ocean views.
The resort's marina has 55 deep-water slips, including five for mega-yachts up to 160 feet.
The marina is the departure point for most of the water-oriented activities at Scrub Island.
Full- or half-day fishing excursions can be booked, complete with boat, guide and equipment.
The resort's cuisine is modern Caribbean with an American flair, using organic herbs, fruits and vegetables from the resort's own garden.
The weekly North Beach Festival is a Caribbean-inspired beach buffet with live entertainment.

highlights.text: The resort sits on a secluded private island in the British Virgin Islands.
Scrub Island Marina is the closest marina to the North Drop, a hot spot for world-record billfish.
Villa guests have a dedicated butler, reachable by WhatsApp, who arranges excursions, island-hopping and private tours.
Ixora Spa is perched high above the Caribbean Sea.
Villa guests can order groceries online and have them delivered to the villa before arrival, and private chef services can be arranged.

considerations.text: Marina guests arriving from outside the British Virgin Islands must clear customs at a BVI port before docking at Scrub Island.
WhataHotel notes limited off-property dining and entertainment options.
